producer_report.summary: athena.toml [capabilities.study] now sets repo_url = "https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate.git" and repo_ref = "main" (the commented example is gone). The config() helper in run_pin_tests.rs now drops every line starting with repo_url or repo_ref from the real athena.toml before it adds its own keys or none. Both cases therefore work and TOML never sees duplicate keys. I added a CHANGELOG entry under Added and a new decision, D77, in docs/decisions.md. I did not run the firstmate study.

checks_run.note: Ran again with -q to read the summary. Every test result line was ok, so the two run_pin_tests tests pass against the configured repo.

open_issues: The helper matches lines by key prefix, so a future key starting with repo_url or repo_ref would also be dropped. D77 records this.
I added the changelog entry under Added, not in a new Changed section.
mistakes: I wrote a stray temp file, docs/d77.tmp, by mistake and deleted it right away.

learnings: The helper's with-repo case inserts the keys right after the [capabilities.study] header, so the real keys had to be stripped first.
